sources.//: This `exclude` list is the template engine's own default list MINUS `**/*.lock.json`, and it exists to keep that one pattern off (FS.GG.Templates#380). The default is not inert: it silently stripped every committed `packages.lock.json` out of each generated workspace, so the reviewed lock could never reach a product. Combined with `Directory.Build.props`'s `RestorePackagesWithLockFile=true`, the product's FIRST restore then AUTHORED its own lock from whatever the ambient host happened to resolve, and `RestoreLockedMode=true` enforced that unreviewed lock forever after — surfacing as `NU1403: Package content hash validation failed` the moment the ambient content moved. Declaring `exclude` here REPLACES the engine default wholesale, so every other default pattern below must be restated verbatim; they are copied from the engine's own defaults (dotnet SDK 10.0.302, Microsoft.TemplateEngine.Orchestrator.RunnableProjects). Removing a line here ships build output into products; adding `**/*.lock.json` back re-opens #380.

productName.description: Raw product name used in paths and display text. When omitted, --name supplies it.
